component.name: Hortus
component.summary: Native Markdown notes with Mermaid diagrams and terminal Agents
原生 Markdown 笔记，支持 Mermaid 图表与终端 Agent

description.p: Hortus is a native Linux Markdown application with local Mermaid diagram rendering, TeX math typesetting, an integrated terminal, and Agent change review tools.
Hortus 是原生 Linux Markdown 应用，内置本地 Mermaid 图表渲染、TeX 数学公式排版、集成终端与 Agent 会话改动审阅。
